add.issue.name: epiq skill: each session boots its own MCP server, so assumed identities do not mix

edit.description.md:
`epiq_actor_assume` binds the identity to the server process it is called on. Two sessions sharing one server, or a session sharing the user's own instance, would sign every write with whichever name was assumed last, and the log would merge them into one contributor.

Add a rule to the skill: every session runs its own epiq MCP instance — the one Claude Code spawns for the session, or one the agent boots itself when that failed to connect — never one shared with another session or with the user. After any restart of that instance the name has to be assumed again.

add.issue.name: epiq_issue_get should carry the ticket's comments — reading one thread costs the whole state today

edit.description.md:
The skill says to read a ticket's comments before starting, and no tool serves them. `epiq_issue_get` returns title, description, tags and assignees; the only place a comment appears is `epiq_state_get`, which is every node with its full log plus the entire event log. Reading one thread on this board today meant a 4,222-event payload.

Add `comments` to the `epiq_issue_get` response: id, author name, time and body, in log order, deleted ones omitted. Attachments alongside if the same read yields them.

add.issue.name: epiq_issue_list: filter by lane, tag, assignee and text, and a brief shape without descriptions

edit.description.md:
Answering "what is in Ongoing" or "which tickets carry from-review" means listing every open ticket with its full description and filtering client-side. On this board that is 134 tickets, most of them several paragraphs: the description is the bulk of the payload and rarely what a list is read for.

Add `swimlaneId`, `tag`, `assignee` and `query` filters, and `brief: true` returning id, ref, title, swimlane title, tag names and assignee names only. The tool description should point agents at `brief` for scanning and `epiq_issue_get` for one ticket.

add.issue.name: Bulk close, move and tag: one call for many tickets

edit.description.md:
A release sweep today closed 82 tickets: 82 calls, each paying boot and a serialized response, and 82 tool results in the agent's context.

`epiq_issue_close`, `epiq_issue_move` and `epiq_issue_tag_add` should accept `issueIds` alongside `issueId`, apply the batch in one materializeAndPersistAll, and return one line per ticket with per-ticket failures rather than aborting the whole batch on the first.

add.issue.comment.md: Deviation: close and move persist one ticket at a time inside the batch, not in one materializeAndPersistAll. Each rank is resolved against materialized state, so two `at: end` moves resolved before either persisted would take the same rank. Tagging needs no rank and persists once. The saving the ticket is after — one round trip, one result in context — holds either way.
add.issue.comment.author: YEZWEN8801VDBA4Q79PDYKGCPX

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 71fbe5ca (PR #231) adds the rule to the epiq skill, between the actor_assume bullet and the clash bullet: the name binds to the server process, so a session runs its own instance — the one Claude Code spawns, or one it boots itself if that never connected — and assumes the name again after any restart.
add.issue.comment.author: YEZWEN8801VDBA4Q79PDYKGCPX

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: a8a51560 (PR #232). epiq_issue_get now returns `comments`: id, author name, createdAt and body, sorted by ULID so they read in log order, deleted ones omitted. Author resolves through the contributor registry with the log name as fallback. Attachments left out; they were not on the same read.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 912e273b (PR #232). epiq_issue_list takes swimlaneId, tag, assignee (names, case-insensitive) and query (title or description), and brief: true returns id, ref, title, swimlane title, tag names and assignee names only. The tool description steers agents to brief for scanning and epiq_issue_get for one ticket.
add.issue.comment.author: YEZWEN8801VDBA4Q79PDYKGCPX

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 2a7a3778 (PR #232). epiq_issue_close, epiq_issue_move and epiq_issue_tag_add accept issueIds (max 200) and return {done, failed} with a reason per failed ticket; the call fails only when nothing went through. Close and move persist per ticket (see the deviation comment); tag validates every target then persists once behind the tag creation. Single issueId calls keep their old response shape.
